title: Actionable-Insight Contract (DC-INSIGHT-v1)
description: Sprint 26 WS-D consumption contract for the 5-beat actionable-insight tuple (design spec Sec 3.1, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-23-sprint-26-decision-ontology-actionable-insight-design.md). A grounded copilot answer is a signal + understanding + recommendation + action + coordination + provenance tuple, not a free-form sentence. Unlike the dc-*-v1 dataset envelopes in this folder, this contract describes a single answer instance (not a {records:[...]} collection): the top level IS the six beats. The Fabric Data Agent (da_hospital_capacity) emits the signal, understanding, and provenance beats; the agent-host assembles the recommendation, action, and coordination beats at runtime. No PHI by construction: provenance.concepts reference only hcp:* reference-layer concepts (ward/bed aggregates), never patient identifiers. See docs/ontology/reference-layer.ttl and docs/ontology/crosswalk.md.

signal.description: The observed metric breach or condition that triggered the insight.

unit.description: Unit of the metric value, e.g. %.

threshold.description: Threshold value the metric is compared against.

scope.description: hcp:* concept reference identifying the scope, e.g. hcp:Ward/Medicine A.

horizon_h.description: Forecast horizon offset in hours (0 = current state).

understanding.description: Explanatory decomposition of the signal into contributing drivers.

delta.description: Signed contribution of this factor to the signal.

note.description: Optional free-text context, e.g. flu season.

recommendation.description: Ranked lever recommendations addressing the signal. Assembled at runtime by the agent-host from the lever catalog (data-platform/decision/levers/<role>.yaml).

params.description: Lever-specific parameters as defined by the lever's params_schema.

owner_role.description: Role responsible for executing the lever, e.g. dca.

action.description: Advisory-only + HITL action state for the selected recommendation (Cosmos proposed_actions record).

cosmos_id.description: Identifier of the proposed_actions record in Cosmos.

coordination.description: Cross-role Plan / CapacityEpisode context and handoff routing.

plan_id.description: Identifier of the Cosmos plans record.

golden_thread.description: Human-readable narrative summary, e.g. Medicine A 102% -> 94%.

handoff.description: Receiving role for this recommendation, e.g. dca.

provenance.description: Grounding provenance for the answer; no PHI by construction.
